title: Grammar: put events in an easy order
subtitle: A2 · Unit 1: A week in my life: connect the details

steps.title: A small sequence makes a longer answer easier to follow
put events in an easy order
steps.body: Notebook move: write one true sentence about your week. Close your notes and say it again with a different connector. Tomorrow, retrieve the idea first, then rebuild the French without looking.

steps.prompt: Je travaille le matin ___ j'étudie le soir. (addition)
Je suis occupée lundi, ___ je suis libre mardi. (contrast)
steps.explain: Mais shows the contrast between busy Monday and free Tuesday.

steps.prompt: Je reporte le cours ___ je travaille. (reason)
steps.explain: Parce que introduces the reason: je travaille.

steps.prompt: Le bus est en retard, ___ j'arrive plus tard. (result)
